cuerpo.name: v1.1.2
cuerpo.body:
### Changelog
- new mark as read/unread submenu when selecting titles
- pages size slider now snaps to stops, tts default voice now follows the one picked in android settings
- new animated startup screen that follows the color theme and dark mode
- <follow up>
- chapter sort now also sets reading order and read progress
- split page indicator with a show whole page button in the reader, new back button hold animation, merged scanlators now count as one everywhere
- redesigned add section popup, safe-only extensions for nsfw-free suggestions
- crash fixes
- bug fixes
- redesigned popup menus across the app
- added home page switching transition
- draggable floating navbar selector and smoother tab switching animation
- bigger extension icons in explore, swapped chapter buttons in rtl reading, smoother scrollbar dragging, fixed add to favourites buttons disappearing on long lists, minor ui improvements
- fixed google drive sync and sign-out failing on renamed gmail accounts
- <ignore>

### Installation Instructions
1. Download and install the apk file first
2. Go to the Explore menu > Manage and click the pen icon to add an extension repo
3. Install and use the extensions, read, add items to the favorites and ENJOY!

If this is your first time using the app, I recommend uninstalling any extension you find when opening the app for the first time and then installing latest extensions from your preferred repository.

cuerpo.name: v1.0.0
cuerpo.body:
### Changelog
- new feature: rotate wide pages to fit (settings>reader)
- fixed pages getting stuck in webtoon mode after jumping with the slider or page list
- reorganized the reader menu, chapters open faster with tracking on, fixed uninstalling sandbox extensions from their settings
- tried fixing pages getting stuck at the top/bottom in webtoon mode
- fixed downloading several manga at once failing to save as cbz
- retry button for failed downloads, read chapters now get deleted as you read
- updated system libraries and other improvements
- renamed and replaced some menus, added more in-depth tags for extensions, new universal sorting option for favorites, fixed novel progress saving, improved slider for changing grid size, grouped notifications for new chapters
- fix: keep history on chapterless migration, load covers without aspect ratio
- fix(extensions): follow index_v2 the Mihon way, drop store-specific fallback
- fix(core): resolve edge cases, crash risks, resource leaks, and data races

### Installation Instructions
